name: Omnivore
author: citybeachsoftware

sections.description:
Unlock the full potential of your WooCommerce store with the Omnivore plugin! Designed to seamlessly integrate your online shop with leading marketplaces, Omnivore opens up a world of opportunities to expand your reach and increase sales. Whether you’re looking to connect with Amazon, eBay, or other major platforms, our plugin makes it easy. Omnivore can manage listings, sync inventory and orders across multiple channels. Simplify your operations and boost your visibility across marketplaces today.

This plugin is ideal for WooCommerce users looking to scale their operations and leverage the power of multi-channel selling.

Key Features:

  • Multi-Marketplace Integration: Connect your WooCommerce store to a variety of marketplaces like Amazon, eBay, and more, enabling you to sell widely and manage all from one dashboard.
  • Real-Time Syncing: Keep your inventory synced across all channels to prevent overselling
  • Tailor your Products for the Marketplace: You can change details such as price, product title, description for each Marketplace without impacting your WooCommerce store.
  • Automated Listing Management: Choose which products are listed on each marketplace
  • Order Aggregation: Streamline your order management by consolidating orders from different marketplaces into your WooCommerce dashboard, making processing and fulfillment more efficient.
  • Advanced Analytics: Gain insights into your sales performance across different channels with our comprehensive analytics tools, helping you make data-driven decisions to grow your business.
  • Dedicated Support: Access our expert team with in-depth knowledge of marketplace dynamics, offering you the guidance needed to optimize your multichannel strategy.

Marketplaces supported

Omnivore supports dozens of marketplaces and adds new ones all the time, for a full list go to Omnivore.

Support

How to guides, email and chat support is available through the Omnivore Help Centre

Find out more about Omnivore
